choices.C: APPROVE AS CANDIDATE, DO NOT ENABLE

proposals.title: Replace removed NOAA solar-wind contracts with RTSW adapters
proposals.category: changed source contract and parser adapter
proposals.exact_change: Sandbox NOAA SWPC rtsw_mag_1m.json and rtsw_wind_1m.json as replacements for the two approved 404 endpoints. Retain official summary magnetic-field and speed files as compact health companions only.
proposals.why: The approved mag-1-day and plasma-1-day URLs return HTTP 404. NOAA states that real-time solar-wind JSON is available and lists the current RTSW one-minute magnetic and plasma files.
proposals.expected_benefit: Restores timestamped Bt, Bz, speed, density, temperature, and quality-aware upstream solar-wind telemetry.
proposals.risks: Large files, source-spacecraft switching, missing or suspect plasma data, parser and retention cost, and accidental treatment of health summaries as full history.
proposals.default_if_no_action: Keep both approved sources failed and do not substitute candidates.

proposals.title: Enable exact raw-body transport and SHA-256 evidence receipts
proposals.exact_change: Run the existing Node 24 harvester in a dispatchable or local worker context that exposes exact response bytes, HTTP metadata, SHA-256 checksums, bounded retention, and idempotent dated artifacts.
proposals.why: The present retrieval layer exposed parsed content but not original bytes. The current bundle therefore cannot honestly verify raw checksums.
proposals.expected_benefit: Reproducible evidence, parser validation, transport-level provenance, and reliable comparison between Night Watch runs.
proposals.risks: Artifact growth, duplicated runs, location metadata precision, permissions, and retention cost.
proposals.privacy_consent: Approximate configured location remains private. Exact location is prohibited without separate explicit approval.
proposals.default_if_no_action: Continue partial evidence bundles and never claim complete raw preservation or checksum verification.

proposals.title: Add bounded NOAA GloTEC regional adapter
proposals.exact_change: Sandbox a regional GloTEC parser with payload-size limits, source timestamps, TEC units, quality and missingness masks, model-assimilation labelling, and approximate-location privacy controls.
proposals.why: NOAA and NCEI identify GloTEC as an operational global near-real-time TEC product available from 2025 onward.
proposals.expected_benefit: Adds ionospheric total-electron-content context for radio propagation and cross-temporal comparisons.
proposals.risks: Large payloads, interpolation complexity, storage growth, and confusion between assimilated model output and direct measurement.
proposals.privacy_consent: Regional sampling must use approximate coordinates and remain private by default.

proposals.title: Add ground geomagnetic observatory source discovery bench
proposals.exact_change: Keep INTERMAGNET disabled while a sandbox study identifies a documented machine endpoint, station selection rules, cadence, licences, quality flags, and Northeast Florida-relevant observatories.
proposals.why: The registry includes INTERMAGNET as candidate-only, but no approved adapter or exact machine contract exists.
proposals.expected_benefit: Adds direct ground magnetic-field measurements independent of planetary Kp.
proposals.risks: Station gaps, licensing or redistribution conditions, heterogeneous cadence, and false equivalence between local station vectors and planetary indices.
proposals.default_if_no_action: Remain candidate-only with no automated retrieval.

proposals.title: Investigate a documented NASA DSN Now data interface
proposals.exact_change: Research whether NASA or JPL exposes a documented machine-readable DSN Now interface. Do not scrape the interactive visualization and do not enable retrieval until permission and contract are verified.
proposals.why: NASA states that DSN Now uses real-time ground-station data updated every five seconds, but the registry correctly lacks an approved machine interface.
proposals.expected_benefit: Potentially adds live antenna, spacecraft-link, band, uplink, downlink, and data-rate telemetry with primary-source provenance.
proposals.risks: Undocumented endpoints, scraping restrictions, display misidentification during off-nominal signal searches, and rapid data volume.
proposals.default_if_no_action: Remain metadata-only and do not scrape.
